body:
Work that keeps agents aligned with the human's direction and the project's standards.

This milestone covers:
- **Personas**: who the software serves, carried into agent briefs.
- **Agent roles**: which agent takes each kind of work.
- **Autorun**: how much work proceeds without human intervention.
- **Built-in quality practices**: the engineering habits Solace expects agents to follow.

Reached when all linked features are complete.
title: Agent Alignment
